title: Luke Skywalker's Confrontation
description: LUKE SKYWALKER'S CONFRONTATION with the Rancor, in this production painting by Ralph McQuarrie (front), occurs in a dungeon-like cage below Jabba's throne room, with bars allowing the palace crowd to watch the mayhem. The monster has already killed a Gamorrean guard unfortunate enough to have fallen into the pit with Luke. Now it grabs Luke, who picks up the long arm bone of an earlier victim and wedges it into the Rancor's salivating mouth.
